Package parking.domain.model

package parking.domain.model
Domain entities and value objects: the innermost layer of the application, following Clean Architecture's dependency rule.

Everything in this package is plain Java with no dependency on any other layer, framework, or storage mechanism. It expresses only the business concepts (vehicles, rates, spaces, tickets, payments) and the rules that are intrinsic to them (e.g. how a rate is computed, how a space validates compatibility). Persistence, orchestration across multiple entities, and any notion of "use case" belong to the parking.application and parking.infrastructure packages instead.
